title: Birth in New Orleans and family without musicians
summary: Williams was born September 1, 1900, in the Third Ward; he was an only child and no one in his family played music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was born in New Orleans, right here. What part of town? In the Third Ward, on Liberty between Lafayette and Padres. 1900 September 1st.
So, uh, can you remember, uh, anything about the, uh, other musicians in the family? Did your mother, father, anybody play against them? Nobody in my family were musicians.
Were you the only child, your brother?
Only child. Only child. Can you remember the first music you heard over in there? Any of the dance bands or parade?
